ZOTAC GAMING GEFORCE RTX 3090 Ti SERIES

 The new ultimate is here with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3090 Ti Series. Focused with function over form, the top-tier AMP Extreme Holo is equipped with the award-winning HoloBlack design and the most powerful IceStorm cooling system from ZOTAC GAMING.

The new ultimate is here with the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 3090 Ti Series. Focused with function over form, the top-tier AMP Extreme Holo is equipped with the award-winning HoloBlack design and the most powerful IceStorm cooling system from ZOTAC GAMING.

...

ADVANCED COOLING

A more refined IceStorm 2.0 cooling system is purpose-built for wider coverage to keep the GPU cooler and running stronger, with enhancements in the visible and in what lies underneath. 

PASS-THRU AIRFLOW

More airflow exit routes across the GPU design including a direct pass-thru airflow vent, which enables faster heat exhaust, reduces trapped heat, and reduces airflow turbulence for overall improved noise and thermal performance.

MAXIMUM AIRFLOW

The ZOTAC GAMING AMP Extreme Holo features the largest ever set of fans used with triple 100mm fans for maximum airflow dynamics.

11-BLADE DESIGN

The 11-blade fan design increases static pressure and airflow by up to 10% compared to previous generation design.

...

The ZOTAC GAMING AMP Extreme Holo features the largest ever set of fans used with triple 100mm fans for maximum airflow dynamics.

...

DESIGNED TO COVER

A wider aluminum fin-stack array heatsink paired with up to eight copper heat pipes span beyond the length of the graphics card board to extract and distribute more heat, more efficiently for maximum cooling performance.

MORE SURFACE CONTACT

The heatpipes shift into a vertical layout as it crosses over the large aluminum surface area baseplate which contact the GPU core. The vertical layout increases heatpipe to cold-block surface area contact by up to 72%, pushing for even more heat extraction.

8 HEATPIPES 

The AMP Extreme Holo features 8 precision machined copper heatpipes, the highest count of heatpipes used on ZOTAC GAMING GPUs, combined with a vapor chamber to ensure full coverage of the GPU surface area for maximum heat extraction. 

COMPOSITE HEATPIPES

Each copper heatpipe is made of composite layers consisting of a thicker envelope and a grooved wick with a multi-channel working fluid.

...

HEIGHT 63.9 mm 

THICKER 

Sitting at a 3.5-slot GPU, the overall heatsink thickness increases 20% for even more surface area and stronger heat dissipation. 

CRITICAL COMPONENT CONTACT 

Memory and VRM modules make contact with the heatsink via premium thermal pads for cooling beyond just the GPU. 

MORE RESILIENT 

The design of the AMP Extreme Holo underlines durability with a metal backplate with a retention mount to increase the overall card rigidity and reinforced support.

...

UNLEASH THE AURORA

The unique HoloBlack design feature embraces an iridescent holographic finish and exudes an aurora like glow. The design captivates your eyes with the dynamic SPECTRA 2.0 RGB lighting paths underneath.

DYNAMIC RGB

SPECTRA 2.0 enables beautiful lighted colors and expressive animated options with powerful Addressable RGB LEDs. Set different lighting modes and colors for specific independent lighting zones, or as a synchronized whole. Tap into the ZOTAC GAMING FireStorm software to make the ZOTAC GAMING graphics card yours with just a few clicks.
